decisions.proposed_text: Trên trời dưới đất, duy ngã độc tôn,\nBạo quân tự xưng là Vua Turf
decisions.reason: Current first line is an unnecessarily stiff Sino-Vietnamese calque and the second uses the forbidden surface label sân cỏ. The revision preserves the boast while applying the established player-facing surface term.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.surface.turf requires 草地 → Turf and forbids Sân cỏ.

decisions.proposed_text: Gentildonna cương nghị.\nChỉ biết mạnh mẽ nở rộ!
decisions.reason: 贵妇人 is the character alias here, not the common noun quý phu nhân. The revision restores the canonical character identity and keeps the forceful blooming image.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded character.gentildonna locks 贵妇人 to Gentildonna.

decisions.proposed_text: Không bao giờ khuất phục.\nDù thua bao nhiêu lần, trái tim này cũng không tan vỡ!
decisions.reason: Bách chiết bất khuất is an unnatural Sino-Vietnamese calque in ordinary Vietnamese prose; the revision preserves the resilient meaning and emotional second line.

decisions.proposed_text: Cao quý, uy nghi\n——Đóa hoa xanh bạc kiêu hãnh nở đơn độc
decisions.reason: Lẫm liệt and bạc xanh are stiff/literal in this poetic description. The revision keeps the noble, solitary silver-blue-flower image in more natural Vietnamese and restores the source dash structure.
Meaning, warning tone, two-line structure, and natural Vietnamese are preserved without canonical or structural conflicts.

Embedded Skill-name matching treats 光明 as the canonical Skill title Ánh sáng, but this sentence uses 光明 compositionally as ordinary light/brightness in prose. Forcing the Skill title here would create a false gameplay-name reading, so the matcher needs contextual narrowing first.

canonical_finding.concept: Skill-name matcher overmatches ordinary light/brightness prose
canonical_finding.reason: In 向光明的彼方前进, 光明 is ordinary prose meaning light/brightness rather than a Skill-name identity. Skill-title locking should not trigger in this descriptive text context.

decisions.reason: The imperative, shining-feet image, loyal/righteous holy-sword motif, and two-line structure are preserved naturally enough without canonical conflicts.

decisions.proposed_text: Mang trong mình một giấc mơ lớn,\nĐội trưởng xung phong tràn đầy ý chí chiến đấu!
decisions.reason: Mang một giấc mơ lớn is slightly fragmentary and bùng cháy đấu chí is a stiff Sino-Vietnamese calque. The revision preserves the energetic charge-leader characterization in natural Vietnamese.

decisions.proposed_text: Lấy thực phẩm làm thuốc——\nMã Nương tiên nhân ung dung tự tại
decisions.reason: The current text incorrectly uses generic Uma Musume for 马娘. Manual audit policy establishes generic 马娘/赛马娘 in world/prose context as Mã Nương; the rest of the meaning is preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: TRANSLATION_REVIEW.md manual-audit policy requires generic 马娘/赛马娘 → Mã Nương and reserves Uma Musume for the franchise title.

decisions.proposed_text: Công lý nghiêm minh, không thiên vị——\nNữ tuần cảnh mặt lạnh đang chạy
decisions.reason: The current second line adds trên đường đua, which is not present in the source, and the first line is a stiff literal construction. The revision removes the unsupported addition and preserves the strict, impartial justice image.
